settings.question: What's in each box?
settings.answer: Eight Janabar bars, mixed across our current flavors. As new destinations launch, they join the rotation.

settings.question: How often will it arrive?
settings.answer: You choose the delivery schedule when you subscribe.

settings.question: Can I skip or cancel?
settings.answer: Yes. Skip a delivery, pause or cancel any time from your account.

settings.question: When will I be charged?
settings.answer: You're charged when you subscribe, then again before each delivery on your schedule.
